Mobile and both lifecycle transcripts include full paused UI: no visible chain or gameplay buttons, modal controls available; playing restores both HUD actions. visual_review.observation: Actual declined offer fits three original cards, REROLL / 2 and enabled optional link. Reopened picker shows HP 100 to 80/+30% cycles and honestly disabled Hive prerequisite. Active view shows Redline 1/3, -20 HP, +30% cycles and next level 10; resumed HUD shows 80 HP/42 shield with touch actions. Separate ordinary Android failure capture remains at the pause menu; Settings transition did not occur. The cause of that timeout is unconfirmed.

reviewer_history.reason: Reviewer incorrectly required the initial level-up entry snapshot to have already rendered. It records upgrading with the previous playing frame; the driver captures the offer before tapping.
reviewer_history.correction: Still compare all seventeen fields entry-to-picker and all exact actions. Require fresh rendered panels/process/counters throughout actual opened -> declined -> reopened path, matching the intended runtime predicates.
